problem.problem:
Charlie is nice. Charlie is quiet. Charlie is white. Charlie is young. Dave is not furry. Gary is quiet. Harry is furry. If something is nice and cold then it is quiet. If something is cold then it is young. Quiet, furry things are white. All furry things are cold. If something is young then it is nice.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Charlie is not white.
raw_logic_programs:
Predicates:
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?
White($x, bool) ::: Is x white?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?

Facts:
Nice(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is nice.
Quiet(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is quiet.
White(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is white.
Young(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is young.
Furry(Dave, False) ::: Dave is not furry.
Quiet(Gary, True) ::: Gary is quiet.
Furry(Harry, True) ::: Harry is furry.

Rules:
Nice($x, True) && Cold($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: If something is nice and cold then it is quiet.
Cold($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: If something is cold then it is young.
Quiet($x, True) && Furry($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: Quiet, furry things are white.
Furry($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: All furry things are cold.
Young($x, True) >>> Nice($x, True) ::: If something is young then it is nice.

Query:
White(Charlie, False) ::: Charlie is not white.
